youtube.title: Isaac Newton's lockdown was better than yours 💀 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Isaac Newton's plague lockdown vs everyone else's 💀

What did YOU do in lockdown? Be honest 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on history: in 1665 the Great Plague closed Cambridge University and Isaac Newton went home to Woolsthorpe. In the next year and a half (his "year of wonders") he worked out early calculus, split white light with prisms and began his theory of gravity. The falling apple is a story Newton himself told later; legend says it was the spark.
